Usage of list tasks:
  -format string
    	output format: table|json|tsv (default "table")
  -include-archived
    	include archived tasks
  -include-done
    	include done tasks (hidden by default)
  -kind string
    	filter by task kind: regular | playbook_run | all (default "regular")
  -no-color
    	disable ANSI color even when stdout is a TTY
  -no-truncate
    	do not truncate the [waiting: ...] field in table output
  -priority string
    	high|medium|low
  -project string
    	project slug
  -since string
    	today|monday|7d|YYYY-MM-DD
  -status string
    	backlog|in-progress|done
  -tag value
    	only tasks carrying this tag (case-insensitive; repeatable — tasks must carry ALL given tags)
